title: Password Generator
description: Generate strong random passwords or memorable passphrases with a live entropy breakdown — bits, total combinations, and estimated crack time — all computed client-side.

title: Gerador de CPF
description: Generates mathematically valid Brazilian CPF numbers (correct check digits) for software testing, with a fiscal-region selector.

title: QR Code Generator / Reader
description: Generate QR codes from text or a URL, or decode one from a photo or live camera — a from-scratch implementation of the QR spec (encoding, Reed-Solomon error correction, masking, and decoding), no library.
